description: Use this when a student asks what score they need on a final exam (or last assignment) to reach a target grade, given the current grade and how much the final counts. Returns the needed percent, whether it is secured or out of reach, what a 0 and a 100 would leave, and the need for every letter. Works with percents (current_grade_percent + final_weight_percent) or with points (points_earned_so_far, points_possible_so_far, final_exam_points). Do not use it for a weighted average of categories.

current_grade_percent.description: Current course grade in percent before the final.

final_exam_points.description: Points mode: points the final is worth.

final_weight_percent.description: How much of the course grade the final counts, in percent.

points_earned_so_far.description: Points mode: points earned so far.

points_possible_so_far.description: Points mode: points possible so far.

scale.description: 10_point (default) or plus_minus, used to read a letter target.

target_grade.description: Wanted grade: a percent (90) or a letter (B+).

name: final_grade_needed

link.description: Page of calculatorforgrading.com with the same inputs filled in.

title: Score needed on the final
